Ms. 2. 76; according to some they are seven in number).

(rarely n. ifc. f(आ). ; fr. व्य्-√ अञ्ज्, to smear over; cf. √ अच्) deceit, fraud, deception, semblance, appearance, imitation, disguise, pretext, pretence (ibc. ‘treacherously, falsely’, also = ifc. ‘having only the appearance of, appearing as, simulated, deceitful, false’; instr. and abl. ‘treacherously, deceitfully’, ‘under the pretext or guise of’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.

wickedness, W.
a: व्याजः — 1 Deceit, trick, deception. fraud. --2 Art, cunning; अव्याजमनोहरं वपुः Ś. 1. 18 ‘artlessly lovely.’ --3 A pretext, pretence, semblance; ध्यानव्याजमुपेत्य Nāg. 1. 1; R. 4. 25, 58; 10. 76; 11. 66. --4 An artifice, a device, contrivance; व्याजार्धसंदर्शितमेखलानि R. 13. 42. --5 Wickedness, depravity. --Comp. --उक्तिः f. {1} a figure of speech in which what is apparently the effect of one cause is intentionally ascribed to another; in other words, where a feeling is dissembled by being attributed to a different cause; see K. P. 10 under व्याजोक्ति. {2} covert allusion, insinuation. --निंदा artful censure. --सुप्त a. feigning to be asleep. --स्तुतिः f. a figure of speech resembling the English ‘irony’, wherein censure is implied by apparent praise, or praise by apparent censure; व्याजस्तुतिर्मुखे निंदा स्तुतिर्वा रूढिरन्यथा K. P. 10.

व्य्-˚आनशिन् mfn. = व्यापन-शील, Sāy.

व्य्-आ˚नोदान m. du. Vyāna and Udāna, AV.

ill-will, malice, W.

व्य्-˚आपाद्य mfn. to be killed or destroyed, MW.

m: व्य्-आपार m. (ifc. f(आ). ) occupation, employment, business, profession, function (सायकानां व्याप्˚, ‘the business of arrows’ i.e. ‘hitting the mark’; often in comp., e.g. मानस-व्य्˚, ‘occupation of mind’, Vedāntas.; वाग्-व्य्˚, ‘employment of speech’, talk, Hit.; गृह-व्य्˚, ‘occ˚ with domestic affairs’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.

doing, performance, action, operation, transaction, exertion, concern (acc. with √ कृ, ‘to perform any one's [gen.] business’, Kathās.; ‘to render good offices in any affair’, Kum.; ‘to meddle in’ [loc.] Pañcat.; with √ व्रज्, ‘to engage in’ [loc.] Vikr.; with √ या, ‘to be concerned about’, ‘care for’ [gen.]), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
N. of the tenth astrol. mansion, VarBṛS.
a: व्यापारः — 1 Employment, engagement, business, occupation; ततः प्रविशति यथोक्तव्यापारा शकुंतला Ś. 1; Ku. 2. 54. --2 Application, employment; Mu. 2. 4. --3 Profession, trade, practice, exercise; as in शस्त्रव्यापार. --4 An act, doing, performance. --5 Working, operation, action, influence; (व्रतं) व्यापाररोधि मदनस्य निषेवितव्य Ś. 1. 27; तस्यानुमेने भगवान् विमन्युर्व्यापारमात्मन्यपि सायकानां Ku. 7. 93; V. 3. 17. --6 Being placed on; M. 4. 14. --7 Exertion, effort; आर्याप्यरुंधती तत्र व्यापारं कर्तुमर्हति Ku. 6. 32 ‘will be pleased to exert herself in that behalf;’ न व्यापारशतेनापि शुकवत्पाठ्यते बकः H. Pr. 43. (व्यापारं कृ {1} to take part in. {2} to have effect on. {3} to meddle; as in अव्यापारेषु व्यापारं यो नरः कर्तुमिच्छति Pt. 1. 21).

m: व्य्-आपारण n. (fr. Caus.) causing to be busy, setting to work, Pāṇ. viii, 2, 104, Sch.
व्य्-आपार—कारक mfn. (ifc.) engaging (in contest) with, Hariv.
व्य्-आपार—कारिन् mfn. (ifc.) performing the function of, being occupied in, exercising or practising, MBh.
व्य्-˚आपारक mfn. (ifc.) having an occupation or function, Kusum.
व्य्-आपार—रोधिन् mfn. hindering the operation of, opposed to the ways of (gen.), Śak.
व्य्-आपार—वत् mfn. effective, L. (-ता f. the possession of a partic. function, Sāh.)
व्य्-आपार—वत्—ता f., the possession of a partic. function, Sāh.

m: व्य्-˚आपारिन् mfn. occ˚, busy, engaged in (comp.), BrahmaP.
व्य्-˚आपारिन् m. a worker agent, dealer, trader, ib.
a: व्यापारिन् — m. 1 A dealer, trader. --2 One who exercises or practises anything.
व्यापारित — p. p. 1 Engaged, occupied, employed, appointed; R. 2. 38. --2 Placed, fixed, set.

m: व्य्-आ-√ पद् Ā. -पद्यते, to fall away, fall into misfortune, perish, be lost, fail, miscarry, MBh.; Suśr.; to disappear, be changed into another sound or symbol, RPrāt., Sch. (cf. व्य्-आपन्न) : Caus. -पादयति, to cause to perish, make worse, injure, hurt, spoil, kill, destroy, MBh.; Kāv. &c.

व्यापद् — f. 1 Calamity, misfortune, affliction; Māl. 9. 36; Bh. 3. 105. --2 Disease. --3 Derangement. --4 Death, decease.

m: व्य्-आपक mf(इका)n. pervading, diffusive, comprehensive, widely spreading or extending, spreading everywhere (व्यापकं न्य्-√ अस् or न्यासं√ कृ, to put or place or fix or make applicable everywhere, AgP.), KaṭhUp.; MBh. &c.
(in logic) invariably pervading or inherent or concomitant (as an attribute which is always found [as smoke] where some other [as fire] is found), Bhāṣāp.; IW. 62
(in law) comprehending all the points of an argument, pervading the whole plea, W.
a: व्यापक — a. (पिका f.) 1 Pervading, comprehensive, diffusive, widely spread, extending over the whole of anything; तिर्यगूर्ध्वमधस्ताच्च व्यापको महिमा हरेः Ku. 6. 71. --2 (In law) Comprehending all the points of an argument. --3 Invariably concomitant. --4 That which is more extensive than the व्याप्य; e. g. in the instance मनुष्यो मर्त्यः; मर्त्यं is व्यापक as it includes मनुष्य, and is more extensive than it. --कः An attribute which is invariably concomitant or inherent. --कं An invariably concomitant or inherent property.

m: व्य्-आपक-न्यास m. (in the Tantra system) a partic. disposition or arrangement of mystical texts over the whole person, L.

व्य्-आपक—त्व n. pervasion, diffusion, comprehensiveness, invariable concomitance or inherence (in logic), BhP.; Bhāṣāp. &c.
व्यापलण्डिका (?), the neck, L.
व्य्-˚आपनीय mfn. to be pervaded or penetrated, permeable, Nir.

a: व्यापनं — 1 Pervading, comprehending, penetrating. --2 Covering.

व्य्-आपत्ति f. falling into calamity or misfortune, suffering injury, failure, loss, ruin, death, ŚrS.; MBh. &c.
disappearance, substitution (of one sound or letter by another), RPrāt.
a: व्यापत्तिः — f. 1 Ruin, calamity, misfortune; Mu. 6. 20; Mk. 6. 1. --2 Substitution of one thing for another. --3 Death; R. 12. 56.

m: व्य्-आ-√ पृ Ā. √ 2. -प्रियते, or -पृणुते, to be occupied or engaged in, be busy about (loc.; or with अर्थम् or हेतोस् ifc.), be employed (in any office), MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus. -पारयति, to cause to be employed, set to work, keep busy, employ with or in or for (instr. loc., or अर्थम् ifc.), ib. (with करम्, to place or fix the hand, Ragh.; with, हस्तम्, to wave the hand, Bālar.; with विलोचनानि, to fix the eyes upon, direct the glance towards, Kum.; with वाणीम्, to use or raise one's voice, Hcar.)

a: व्यापृत — p. p. 1 Engaged in, occupied or busy with, employed in (with loc.); अन्यस्मिन्कर्मणि व्यापृतं धनुः Ś. 6. 31. --2 Placed, fixed. --m. An employé, a minister.

invariably inherent or concomitant (in logic), Bhāṣāp.

‘arranger, compiler’, N. of a celebrated mythical sage and author (often called Veda-vyāsa and regarded as the original compiler and arranger of the Vedas, Vedānta-sūtras &c.; he was the son of the sage Parāśara and Satyavatī, and half-brother of Vicitra-vīrya and Bhīṣma; he was also called Vādarāyaṇa or Bādarāyaṇa, and Kṛṣṇa from his dark complexion, and Dvaipāyana because he was brought forth by Satyavatī on a Dvīpa or island in the Jumnā; when grown up he retired to the wilderness to lead the life of a hermit, but at his mother's request returned to become the husband of Vicitra-vīrya's two childless widows, by whom he was the father of the blind Dhṛtarāṣṭra and of Pāṇḍu; he was also the father of Vidura [q.v.] by a slave girl, and of Śuka, the supposed narrator of the Bhāgavata-Purāṇa, he was also the supposed compiler of the Mahā-bhārata, the Purāṇas, and other portions of Hindū sacred literature; but the name Vyāsa seems to have been given to any great typical compiler or author), MBh.; Hariv.; Pur. cf. IW. 371 n. 2; 373 &c.

a: व्यासः — 1 Distribution, separation into parts. --2 Dissolution or analysis of a compound. --3 Severalty, distinction. --4 Diffusion, extension. --5 Width, breadth. --6 The diameter of a circle. --7 A fault in pronunciation. --8 Arrangement, compilation. --9 An arranger, a compiler. --10 N. of a celebrated sage. [He was the son of the sage Parāśara by Satyavatī (born before her marriage with Śantanu q. v.); but he retired to the wilderness as soon as he was born, and there led the life of a hermit, practising the most rigid austerities until he was called by his mother Satyavatī to beget sons on the widows of her son Vicitravīrya. He was thus the father of Pāṇḍu and Dhṛtarāṣṭra and also of Vidura; q.q. v.v. He was at first called ‘Kṛṣṇadvaipāyana’ from his dark complexion and from his having been brought forth by Satyavatī on a Dvīpa or island; but he afterwards came to be called Vyāsa or ‘the arranger’, as he was supposed to have arranged the Vedas in their present form; विव्यास वेदान् यस्मात्स तस्माद् व्यास इति स्मृतः. He is believed to be the author of the great epic the Mahābhārata which he is said to have composed with Gaṇapati for his scribe. The eighteen Purāṇas, as also the Brahma-sūtras and several other works are also ascribed to him. He is one of the seven chirajīvins or deathless persons; cf. चिरजीविन्]. --11 A Brāhmaṇa who recites or expounds the Purāṇas in public.

व्य्-˚आवल्गित mfn. rushing or sweeping along in gusts (as the east wind), MBh.
a: व्यावल्गित — p. p. Moved, agitated.

m: व्य्-आ-√ वप् only in pr. Subj. -वपाति w.r. in Pāṇ. iii, 1, 34, Sch. (Kāś. & TS. च्यावयाति).
व्य्-आ-√ वर्ण् (only ind.p. -वर्ण्य), to enumerate, narrate in detail, Kathās.
व्य्-आवर्ग See व्य्-आ-√ वृज्.
व्य्-आवर्ग m. a division, section, Lāṭy.
व्य्-आवर्त &c. See below.
व्य्-आवर्त m. revolving, W.
encompassing, surrounding, ib.
separating, selecting, appointing, ib.
ruptured navel (= नाभि-कण्टक), L.
a: व्यावर्तः — 1 Surrounding, encompassing. --2 Revolution, going round. --3 Ruptured navel.

m: व्य्-˚आवर्तक mf(इका)n. separating, removing, excluding, excepting (-ता f. -त्व n.), Śāntiś.; Tarkas.; Vedāntas. &c.
distinguishing, distinctive, MW.
turning away from, ib.
encircling, encompassing, ib.
a: व्यावर्तक — a. (र्तिका f.) 1 Encompassing, surrounding. --2 Excluding, separating, restricting. --3 Turning away from. --4 Turning round.

व्य्-˚आवर्तक—त्व n.
व्य्-˚आवर्तनीय mfn. to be taken back (see अ-व्यावर्त्˚).
व्य्-˚आवर्तन mf(ई)n. averting, removing (cf. विग्रह-व्यावर्तनी)
excluding, Śaṃk.
व्य्-˚आवर्तन n. turn (of a road), AV.; ChUp.
coil (of a snake), Kir.
turning away, Sāh.
turning round, revolving, encompassing, surrounding, W.
a: व्यावर्तनं — 1 Surrounding, encompassing. --2 Revolving, turning round; Ki. 5. 30. --3 A fold, band.

m: व्य्-˚आवर्तित mfn. (fr. Caus.) made to turn away, made to desist, made to revolve, MW.
exchanged, ib.

m: व्य्-˚आवर्त्य mfn. to be removed or excluded or excepted, Kusum.
व्य्-आ-√ वृ only pr.p. Ā. -वृण्वान, hiding one's self, BhP. i, 11, 38 (B. व्य्-आ-पृन्वान, which accord. to Sch. = व्य्-आ-प्रियमाण).
व्य्-आ-√ वृ only 3. pl. impf. P. व्यावृण्वन्, ‘they chose’, MBh. (B.) i, 4413 (C. व्यवृण्वन्)
a: व्यावृ — {c5c} U. 1 To select, choose. --2 To hide, conceal. --3 To obstruct, impede.

m: व्य्-आ-√ वृज् (only ind.p. -वृज्य) to exclude from (abl.), separate, divide, Br.

व्य्-आ-√ वृत् Ā. -वर्तते (rarely P.), to become separated or singled out from (instr.), RV.; AV.; Br.; to become separated or distinct, be distinguished as or in some partic. form of MaitrUp.; to turn or wind in different directions, divide (as a road), MBh.; to be dispersed (as an army), Hariv.; to be opened, Suśr.; to turn away from, part with, get rid of (instr. or abl.), Ragh.; Kathās.; to diverge from, be inconsistent with (abl.), Sarvad.; to go away, depart, Śāntiś.; to come back, return, Ratnāv.; Rājat.; to turn round, revolve, R.; to sink (as the sun), MBh.; to come to an understanding or settlement, AitBr.; to come to an end, cease, perish, disappear, MBh.; Hariv. &c.: Caus. -वर्तयति (Pass. -वर्त्यते), to divide, separate from (instr. or abl.; ind.p. -वर्त्य, ‘with the exception of’, Bālar.), TBr. &c. &c.; to free from (instr.), MaitrS.; to turn about or round, MBh.; Kād.; to keep back, avert, R.; to throw about, strew, MBh.; to exchange, substitute one for another, Hariv.; to lay aside (the staff), R.; (with अन्यथा) to retract (a word), MBh.; to remove (pain or distress), Vikr.; to destroy or annul (an enemy or a rule), Ragh. xv, 7 : Desid. -विवृसते, to wish or intend to liberate one's self from or get rid of (abl.), ŚBr.
व्य्-आवृत् f. distinction, superiority, pre-eminence over (gen. or instr.), TS.; TBr.; Kāṭh.
cessation, TBr.
a: व्यावृत् — {c1c} A. 1 To turn away from, turn back; सहभुवा व्यावर्तमाना ह्निया Ratn. 1. 2. --2 To be turned or withdrawn from, to be averse to; विषयव्यावृत्तकौतूहलः V. 1. 8. --3 To become separate or distinct from. --4 To turn round, revolve. --5 To go down, set (as the sun). --6 To cease to exist, perish. --7 To be opened or split asunder. --Caus. 1 To restrict, limit, exclude, arrest; overrule, annul, (as a rule &c.); तुशब्दः पूर्वपक्षं व्यावर्तयति Ś. B.; अपवाद इवोत्सर्गं व्यावर्तयितुमश्विरः R. 15. 7. --2 To dissuade from, cause to turn away from; नेयमस्माद्व्यवसायात्कथंचिदपि शक्यते व्यावर्तयितुं K. 172. --3 To destroy, remove; V. 5. 16. --4 To turn round, cause to revolve. --5 To separate from. --6 To scatter, strew.

m: 1. व्य्—आवृत mfn. (for 2. See under व्य्-आ-√ वृ) uncovered, opened, open to (loc.), Ragh. i, 19 (v.l.)
2. व्य्-आवृत mfn. (for 1. See p. 1028, col. 3) covered, screened, W.
removed, excepted, ib. (cf. व्य्-आवृत्त).
a: व्यावृत — p. p. 1 Covered, hid, screened. --2 Impeded, obstructed. --3 Opened. --4 Excepted, excluded.

m: व्य्-˚आवृति f. covering, screening, W.
exclusion, ib. (cf. व्य्-अवृत्ति).
a: व्यावृतिः — f. Covering, screening.

m: व्य्-आवृत्—काम (˚वृत्-), mfn. desirous of superiority, TS.
व्य्-˚आवृत्सु w.r. for व्य्-आविवृत्सु.
व्य्-आवृत्˚तात्मन् mfn. = ˚त्त-चेतस्, Ragh.

m: व्य्-आवृत्त mfn. turned away from, freed from, rid of (instr. abl., or comp.), AV.; MaitrS.; Kālid. &c.
split asunder, opened, Hariv.; Suśr.
(ifc.) different from, Kap.
averted, R.; Kathās.
distorted, ṢaḍvBr.
turned back, returned from (abl.), Campak.
(ifc.) incompatible or inconsistent with, Bhāṣāp.
thoroughly liberated or emancipated (as the soul), Kap.
ceased, disappeared, gone, Kum.
‘chosen’ or ‘fenced’ (= वृत), L.
excepted, excluded, W.
praised, hymned (?), ib.
a: व्यावृत्त — p. p. 1 Turned a way from, withdrawn from; व्यावृत्ता यत्परस्वेभ्यः श्रुतौ तस्करता स्थिता R. 1. 27; V. 1. 8. --2 Separated from, singled out. --3 (a) Excluded, set aside; different from; अयमर्थोऽस्माद् व्यावृत्तः Tarka K. (b) Not being found or existing in, absent from (frequently used in phil. in this sense); धूमो जलहदादेर्व्यावृत्तः Tarka K.; Mu. 5. 10. --4 Revolved, turned round. --5 Encompassed, surrounded. --6 Desisting, ceased from; Ku. 2. 35. --7 Split asunder. --Comp. --गति a. desisting from any course of action.

k.v: वृत्ते तु वृत्तव्यावृत्तौ संयोजित उपाहितः। प्राप्यं गम्यं समासाद्यं  स्यन्नं रीणं स्नुतं स्रुतम्.।

m: व्य्-आवृत्त—शिरस् mfn. having the head turned round, R.
व्य्-आवृत्त—बुद्धि f. ‘limited conception’, the conception of a class containing few individuals. (or of a class comprised in a higher class), MW.
व्य्-आवृत्त—चेतस् mfn. one whose mind is turned away from (abl.), Kathās.
व्य्-आवृत्त—देह mfn. having the body split or burst asunder (said of a mountain), Hariv.
व्य्-आवृत्त—गति mfn. one whose movement has ceased, abated, subsided, lulled (as wind), Kum.
व्य्-आवृत्त—कौतूहल mfn. one whose interest is diverted from (comp.), Vikr.
व्य्-आवृत्त—सर्वेन्द्रियार्थ mfn. turned away from all objects of sense, indifferent to all worldly matters, Pañcat.
व्य्-आवृत्त—त्व n. the being separated or excluded from, inconsistency or incompatibility with (comp.), Sāh.

(in phil.) the being separated from, the being non-extensive (= अल्प-देश-वृत्तित्वम्, ‘existing in few places’, i.e. ‘comprising but few individuals’, said of a species, and opp. to अधिक-द्˚-वृ˚, ‘existing in many places’, said of a genus), MW.
व्य्-आवृत्˚तेन्द्रिय mfn. (ifc.) having the senses averted from, MaitrUp., Sch.

m: व्य्-˚आवृत्ति f. turning away, turning the back (see अव्यावृ˚)
rolling (the eyes), Suśr.
deliverance from, getting rid of (abl.), TS.; Śāntiś.
being deprived of, separation or exclusion from, Śaṃk.
exclusion, rejection, removal, Kum.; Kāvyād.; Sāh. (cf. परस्पर-व्य्˚)
discrimination, distinction, TS.; ŚBr.
distinctness (of sound or voice), Kāṭh.
difference, AitBr.; Nyāyas., Sch.
cessation, end, ĀpŚr.
a kind of sacrifice, ŚBr.
screening (prob. for व्य्-आवृति), ib.
praise, eulogium (?), ib.
a: व्यावृत्तिः — f. 1 Covering, screening. --2 Exclusion, separation. --3 Not being found in, absence from; विपक्षाद्व्यावृत्तिः Tarka K. --4 Surrounding. --5 Rolling backwards. --6 Praise, eulogium. --Comp. --बुद्धि f. the notion of exclusion.

displaced, distorted, MBh.; R.; Daś.; Suśr. (अम् ind., Car.)
interlaced, entwined, MW.
व्य्-आविद्धम् ind., Car.
व्य्-आविवृत्सु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to get rid of (abl. or comp.), Sāy.
व्य्-आ-√ व्यध् P. -विध्यति, to throw or wave about, brandish, MBh.; R.

m: व्य्-आयाम m. dragging different ways, contest, strife, struggle, AV.; MBh.
exertion, manly effort, athletic or gymnastic exercise (e.g., ‘playing with heavy clubs’, ‘drawing a bow with a chain’ &c.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
(ifc.) exercise or practise in MBh.; R.; Suśr.
(with Buddhists) right exercise or training, MWB. 44 (cf. Dharmas. 119)
‘drawing out, extending’, a partic. measure of length, fathom (= वि-याम and व्य्-आम), Śulbas.
a difficult passage, any difficulty (?), L.
a: व्यायामः — 1 Extending, stretching out. --2 Exercise, gymnastic or athletic exercise; स्थाने शमवतां शक्त्या व्यायामे वृद्धिरंगिनां Śi. 2. 94. --3 Fatigue, labour. --4 Effort, exertion. --5 Contention, struggle. --6 Business, occupation. --7 A difficulty. --8 A measure of distance (= व्याम q. v.).

m: व्य्-आयाम—भूमि f. exercising ground, gymnasium, Kām.
व्य्-आयाम—शाला f. an exercising hall, Kād.
व्य्-आयाम—शील mfn. accustomed to or fond of exercise, active, robust, athletic, W.
व्य्-आयाम—कलह m. du. contest and strife, ib.
व्य्-आयाम—कर्शित mfn. emaciated through bodily exercise, MBh.
व्य्-आयाम—प्रयोग m. N. of wk.
व्य्-आयाम—वत् mfn. taking bodily exercise g. बलादि
व्य्-आयाम—विद् mfn. skilled in gymnastics, Rājat.
व्य्-आयाम—विद्या f. the science of g˚, ib.
व्य्-˚आयामिक mf(ई)n. relating to exercise, active, athletic, BhP., Sch.
a: व्यायामिक — a. (की f.), व्यायामिन् a. Athletic, gymnastic.

m: व्य्-˚आयामिन् mfn. = आयाम-वत्, VarBṛS.; Vāgbh.
व्य्-आयच्छन See प्राण-व्य्˚.

(P. only mc.) to struggle or contend about (loc.), fight together, make efforts, strive, endeavour, TS.; Br.; MBh. &c.: Caus. यामयति or यमयति, to cause to stretch out or struggle, make great effort or exertion, take exercise (ind.p. -याम्य, having taken exercise), Mn. vii, 216.
a: व्यायम् — {c1c} P. 1 To stretch out, extend. --2 To struggle, contend, fight. --3 To try, strive, endeavour. --4 To sport, dally.

opened, expanded (see comp.)

a: व्यायतत्वं — Muscular development; Ś. 2. 4.

D.: --ख्यातेतिवृत्तो व्यायोगः स्वल्पस्त्रीजनसंयुतः . हीनो गर्भविमर्षाभ्यां नरैर्बहुभिराश्रितः . एकांकश्च भवेदस्त्रीनिमित्तसमरोदयः . कौशिकीवृत्तिरहितः प्रख्यातस्तत्र नायकः . राजर्षिरथ दिव्यो वा भवेद्धीरोद्धतश्च सः . हास्यशृंगारशांतेभ्य इतरेऽत्रांगिनो रसाः .. 514.
